# Contributing to TFG-RetChanges

This is a fork of [TerraFirmaGreg-Modern](https://github.com/TerraFirmaGreg-Team/Modpack-Modern).

- **For upstream changes** (bug fixes, features that belong in the base pack): contribute to the [original repository](https://github.com/TerraFirmaGreg-Team/Modpack-Modern/blob/dev/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). Their contributing guide has detailed setup instructions.
- **For RetChanges-specific changes** (recipe overrides, config tweaks, fork-only features): PRs are welcome. Please open an issue first to discuss what you'd like to change.
